name: Sossou S. Adjisse, Ph.D.
expertise: Applied economics; causal inference; development and public policy
bio: Dr. Sossou S. Adjisse is an assistant professor of economics at West Virginia State University and a member of the organizing effort behind ERS–WVSU. His research interests include applied economics, policy evaluation, and the use of evidence to understand economic and social outcomes.
past_talk: Economics as a Meeting Place: Research, Collaboration, and Student Opportunity
past_talk_note: September 24, 2026 | 12:30–1:30 p.m. EDT. Inaugural ERS–WVSU seminar introducing the research exchange and interdisciplinary collaboration opportunities.
